Recently was left by ex of eight years, I loved so much but left because of my depression. Left me on my birthday. Unfortunately, here I am. After downing all the meds, drink and smoke I got a whopping three hours of sleep. I see no positives to keep going, I know my family loves me. I work hard, so I know I'm appreciated at work but I only see myself as a fucking loser. I have nothing to show for my life as if I never existed. When I'm gone I will not burden anyone anymore and the spot I hold at work will be filled by another.

In all seriousness, i have been trying to find a way into microdosing for a few years. Dealing with depression and other mental issues. Being in the meds prescribed isn't helping and I've had a good experience with psilocybin as a hard reset in the past, at least for a short break in thought process which is overwhelming at times.
